history.overview: Fissure Ridge is the most unstable elevation of the Causeway, torn open by Discord eruptions.

timeline.name: Ridge Formation
timeline.description: Dragorn artisans carved the ridge as a ceremonial high path.

timeline.name: Bridge Era
timeline.description: Stone bridges connected ridge altars and ceremonial points.

timeline.name: Muramite Invasion
timeline.description: Muramite forces seized the ridge but avoided unstable fissures.

timeline.name: Discord Eruption
timeline.description: Massive fissures tore open the ridge, corrupting stone and altars.
